svg.text: Same services, code and security model as prod; drops always-on and perimeter costs. Idle cost is close to $0.
identity authorizer (User profile Lambda, cached) · throttling
Internal API — API Gateway HTTP API, IAM auth (SigV4) · caller allow-list · user context forwarded
callers: AI assistant (tools), Data pipeline (ownership check, import) · targets: Ledger, Analytics, User profile, Knowledge
EventBridge bus · SQS + DLQ per consumer
UploadAccepted · StatementDeleted (Ledger outbox → relay Lambda → Document svc) · UserAccountDeleted → all · UserDataDeleted → User profile
AWS managed services — each service uses its own IAM role; the SDK signs every call (SigV4)
presigned PUT → quarantine · presigned GET ← clean (files never pass through a service)
profile = dev — what this setting turns on
• Aurora min 0 ACU (auto-pause after 5 min), single writer, 1-day backups
• Ledger: Lambda in VPC (SnapStart); AI assistant: streaming Lambda behind the chat API
• DB parameter idle_session_timeout = 60s so idle JDBC sessions let Aurora pause
• No WAF, NAT or endpoints; AWS-managed keys until invited testers (then CMKs)
• Outbox relay disabled by default; 1 min when testing, hourly with testers
• Reserved concurrency on AI Lambda; per-user token cap; throttles: API ~10 rps, chat ~2 rps
• Log retention 7 days; Budgets alerts at $10 / $25
user request: HTTPS + Cognito token, checked by the identity authorizer
internal call: SigV4 (which service) + forwarded user context (which user)
direct client to and from S3 (presigned upload and download)
